welcome.title: Welcome to Hart County
body: Welcome to the official Hart County website. Here you can find county news, alerts, meeting information, and resources for residents, businesses, and visitors.
We are committed to providing clear, timely information and making county services easier to access online.

extraCards.title: Public Notices
body: Additional public notices can be posted here as needed.
Use this card area for updates that should be visible on the home page but do not fit in the main alert or news sections.

extraCards.title: County Information
body: This section can also be used for seasonal updates, office closures, road work notices, or other important county information.
